name: Oribe Azuki
source:
[url=/c45355]Kokoro's[/url] mother, and the owner-operator of Cafe Origami, where [url=/c45359]Makoto[/url] is staying. She's a laid back and kind woman, but some say she's a bit of an airhead too. Many of the cafe's customers have become regulars thanks to the combination of her pleasant personality and her first-rate cooking skills.


Special skills: Smiling cheerily
Hobbies: Chess, crossword puzzles (knows the weirdest trivia)
Likes: [url=/c45355]Her daughter[/url], texting, shopping for clothes
Dislikes: Ghosts, tough math, hot drinks

[Based on translation from the [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/amatsutsumi/#prettyPhoto]Developer's Site[/url]]
